mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.school_id, s.school_name AS school_name, NULL AS user_id, NULL AS username, t.teacher_code AS job_number, t.teacher_name AS name, t.gender, t.phone, t.email, NULL AS id_card, t.subject, t.title, NULL AS entry_date, t.status, '' AS remark, t.create_time FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN school s ON t.school_id = s.id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM teacher WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
